loops.note: Vocabulary rebuilt from the ground up: 4,316 of 4,316 official entries now traceable, all four slang senses gone, 3,475 glosses hand-authored against the official part of speech, and tone colour moved from a render-time guess to build-time data — every one of 7,907 syllables is painted, where loop 1 coloured only the 29% of words that were monosyllabic. Every piece still fails, but on second-order problems now. The sharpest finding: the sense splitter does not know the word "or", so 47 same-level pairs share a primary gloss and the app can mark a right answer wrong.

verdicts.biggestGap: Teach the sense splitter the word "or", in both places it lives, then fix everything it flags.
Stop deciding what to erase by comparing two wall-clock timestamps. Make a reset a fact recorded in the payload, not an inequality against Date.now().
